title: CAM-Pipeline Track — PostProcessor Completion + Novel Algorithms + Pipeline Architecture
brief: Complete 13 unimplemented PostProcessor stages by wiring existing engines, close 12 partial pipeline gaps, add 10 novel algorithms, extend pipeline architecture, and finish CK track.

milestones.title: PostProcessor Stage Completion — Wire 16 Unimplemented Stages
milestones.brief: 13 StageConfig flags in PostProcessorPipelineEngine have declared interfaces but zero backing code. The engines to power them already exist. This milestone wires each flag to its backing engine, achieving 35/35 implemented stages.

units.title: Wire toolpath_smoothing (stage 3.1) — ToolpathSmoothingEngine
units.description: Wire ToolpathSmoothingEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.toolpath_smoothing is true: extract block XYZ coordinates, apply auto-selected smoothing (B-spline for dense, Bezier for sparse, corner-round for moderate), write smoothed coords back to blocks. Report max_chord_error_mm, smoothing_type, points_modified. Gate: skip if chord_error would exceed tightest block tolerance.
exit_conditions: Stage 3.1 pushes result to stages array
Chord error reported and gated against tolerance

units.title: Wire look_ahead (stage 3.3) — MotionDynamicsProfileEngine
units.description: Wire MotionDynamicsProfileEngine bidirectional look-ahead into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.look_ahead is true: build segment array from blocks, run lookAheadSimulation with machine axis limits from resolved context, clamp block feed rates to achievable values. Report segments_limited, avg_feed_effectiveness, unreachable_feed_count.
exit_conditions: Feed rates clamped to achievable values

units.title: Wire machine_error_comp (stage 3.4) — MachineToolErrorBudgetEngine
units.description: Wire MachineToolErrorBudgetEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.machine_error_comp is true: compute 21-error model with Abbe amplification for resolved machine, apply thermal growth delta=alpha*DT*L as coordinate offsets. Report total_error_um, top_contributors, budget_utilization_pct.

units.title: Wire multi_axis (stage 3.6) — FiveAxisToolpathIntegrationEngine
units.description: Wire FiveAxisToolpathIntegrationEngine singularity detection + TCPC compensation into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.multi_axis is true and 5-axis blocks detected: run Jacobian singularity check, apply SLERP retraction if near singularity, linearize 5-axis moves per tolerance. Report singularity_zones, linearization_count, max_orientation_error_deg.

units.title: Wire spindle_harmonics (stage 1.4) — Inline resonance avoidance
units.description: Add stage 1.4_spindle_harmonics to PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.spindle_harmonics is true: compute tooth-passing frequency ftp=n*z/60, check against spindle natural frequencies (from machine profile or default 800/1600/3200 Hz), check harmonics 1-5. If within 10% of resonance, shift RPM to nearest stable pocket. Report harmonics_checked, rpm_shifted, original_rpm, new_rpm.
units.backing_engine: inline (uses StochasticChatterEngine stability lobe data if available)

units.title: Wire uncertainty_propagation (stage 4.2) — UncertaintyPropagationPipeline
units.description: Wire UncertaintyPropagationPipeline (VAR-MS0) into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.uncertainty_propagation is true: chain force→deflection→dimensional→surface distributions across blocks. Report propagated_uncertainty_sources, force_ci95, dimension_ci95, cpk_prediction.

units.title: Wire dimensional_verification (stage 4.3) — StochasticDimensionalEngine
units.description: Wire StochasticDimensionalEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.dimensional_verification is true: run 7-source MC for critical dimensions from context, predict Cpk over production run, report time_to_first_oos, optimal_tool_change_interval, variance_decomposition.

units.title: Wire surface_finish_verification (stage 4.4) — StochasticSurfaceFinishEngine
units.description: Wire StochasticSurfaceFinishEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.surface_finish_verification is true: predict Ra distribution with MC, check against required Ra from context. Report ra_mean, ra_p95, probability_of_exceeding_spec.

units.title: Wire environmental (stage 4.5) — EnvironmentalVariationEngine
units.description: Wire EnvironmentalVariationEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.environmental is true: model diurnal/seasonal thermal cycles, CTE mismatch between tool/workpiece/machine, humidity effects on dimensional stability. Report thermal_shift_um, cpk_impact, recommended_warm_up_minutes.

units.title: Wire batch_variability (stage 4.6) — MaterialBatchVariabilityEngine
units.description: Wire MaterialBatchVariabilityEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.batch_variability is true: run Cholesky-correlated MC on material properties (hardness, kc1.1, mc, tensile), predict force/life variation across material batches. Report batch_force_cv_pct, batch_life_cv_pct, recommended_safety_margin.

units.title: Wire reliability_check (stage 5.6) — ReliabilityEngineeringEngine
units.description: Wire ReliabilityEngineeringEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.reliability_check is true: compute Weibull tool life reliability R(t)=exp(-(t/eta)^beta), predict optimal replacement interval, check against planned operation time. Report reliability_at_end_of_op, recommended_tool_change_point, failure_probability.

units.title: Wire acoustic_check (stage 5.7) — MachiningAcousticsEngine
units.description: Wire MachiningAcousticsEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.acoustic_check is true: compute Kopac cutting noise level, aggregate with machine background, check ISO 4869 exposure limits. Report noise_level_dba, exposure_limit_exceeded, hearing_protection_required.

units.title: Wire probe_routines (stage 6.2) — ProbeRoutineGeneratorEngine
units.description: Wire ProbeRoutineGeneratorEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.probe_routines is true: generate in-process probe G-code for critical dimensions from context, insert at appropriate points in output program. Report probe_points_generated, critical_dimensions_probed.

units.title: Wire setup_sheet (stage 6.3) — SetupSheetFromGCodeEngine
units.description: Wire SetupSheetFromGCodeEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.setup_sheet is true: generate comprehensive setup sheet from pipeline context (part info, tool list, work offsets, fixture notes, cycle time, safety notes). Populate pipeline output.setup_sheet field.

units.title: Wire controller_params (stage 6.4) — ControllerDialectEngine extended
units.description: Wire ControllerDialectEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine for controller-specific parameter injection. When stageFlags.controller_params is true: inject G10 work offset setup, macro variable initialization, controller-specific safety blocks. Report params_injected, controller_dialect, features_used.

units.title: Wire digital_twin (stage 6.7) — ProcessDigitalTwinEngine
units.description: Wire ProcessDigitalTwinEngine into PostProcessorPipelineEngine. When stageFlags.digital_twin is true: export digital twin state (workpiece geometry, tool state, machine state, process parameters) for real-time monitoring integration. Report twin_state_exported, data_points, monitoring_endpoints.

milestones.title: Pipeline Integration — Close 12 Partial Gaps
milestones.brief: Wire existing engine capabilities into the pipeline flow: servo lag compensation, rotary axis dynamics, trochoidal+depth, vibration-aware bar stock, distortion-compensated multi-setup, generative fixture planning, turning in PrintToProgram, toolpath tolerance verification, within-op cut reordering, post-processor compatibility filter, SelfLearning integration, stochastic geometry from CAD.

milestones.title: Novel Algorithms — 10 True Innovations
milestones.brief: Clothoid/Euler spiral blending, wear-pattern-aware refinishing, PH curves, multi-body coupled vibration, thermal field-aware toolpath, minimum-jerk trajectory, Voronoi-medial-axis pocketing, stochastic toolpath routing, inverse thermal compensation, contact-mechanics surface integrity.

milestones.title: Pipeline Architecture Extensions
milestones.brief: Phase 7 learning feedback, Phase 8 output variants, multi-process router, parallel operation optimization, IPW voxel grid upgrade, tolerance-driven parameter selection.

milestones.title: CK Track Completion + Integration Tests
milestones.brief: Complete CK-MS9 through CK-MS13 and WIRE-MS0: Zod schemas, turning profiles, 2D nesting, DXF/SVG import, stochastic routing, NL CAM interface, G-code diff, result cache, end-to-end integration tests, full dispatcher wiring.
